paper.title: Performance assessment of the effective core potentials under the Fermionic neural network: first and second row elements
paper.authors: Mengsa Wang, Yuzhi Zhou, Han Wang

results.system_description: Li atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 2 up and 1 down electrons
results.variant: Modified FermiNet, all electrons, 10×10^4 training iterations
results.eligibility_evidence: All-electron VMC energy of the trained network as printed; the paper does not describe a separate evaluation run.
results.notes: N_up = 2, N_down = 1: not printed, but the 2S ground term of Li lies only in this sector (up to the mirror N_up <-> N_down). Printed as '-7.47786(2)\{10\}': the number in curly braces is the number of training iterations in units of 10^4 (caption), not part of the energy.
